tools.name: list_currencies
tools.description: Every currency on the NetArz Tehran free-market board: ISO code, Persian and English name, quote unit (some are quoted per 10 or 100 units) and its netarz.ir page. Pro-only currencies are listed with pro_only=true. فهرست ارزهای تابلوی نرخ نِت اَرز با واحد مظنه و نشانی صفحهٔ هر ارز.

tools.name: get_rate
tools.description: Today's Tehran free-market rate of one currency in Toman (IRT): buy, sell and mid per quote unit, change against yesterday, and the time of the data. نرخ امروز یک ارز در بازار آزاد تهران به تومان: خرید، فروش، میانگین و تغییر نسبت به دیروز.

tools.name: get_rates_table
tools.description: The whole board, or the codes you list, as structured rows plus a ready-to-show markdown table (buy / sell / mid in Toman, change vs yesterday). جدول نرخ همهٔ ارزها یا ارزهای انتخابی، با جدول markdown آماده.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Convert an amount between any two currencies, Toman (IRT) or Rial (IRR; 1 Toman = 10 Rial), through the board's dollar rate. side=mid (default), buy or sell. تبدیل مبلغ بین دو ارز، تومان یا ریال با نرخ تابلو.

tools.name: get_history
tools.description: Daily Tehran open-market closing rate of a currency in Toman, with Gregorian and Jalali (Persian calendar) dates. tools.name: get_gold_prices
tools.description: Global gold and silver ounce in USD, and Toman values of 18k gold per gram, mesghal and coins as NetArz publishes them. The Toman gold figures are COMPUTED from the ounce and the dollar — not the Tehran market price (no premium or making charge); say so when you quote them. انس طلا و نقره و ارزش محا

findings.title: Hidden characters in tool description
findings.detail: Description of "get_gold_prices" contains 1 invisible/zero-width or bidi character(s). Legitimate descriptions have no reason to hide text the model still reads.
